<notes>
All three rollouts succeeded consistently with identical answers (Saturday), using the same harness and producing the correct result with minimal token consumption (1 step, ~1680 tokens each). 

No divergence between runs exists — they all followed the same path to the same correct answer. No repeated failures or errors appear in any trajectory. The harness efficiently performs one LLM call to a frozen model, extracts the final line as the deliverable, and needs no tool use, verification, or multi-step procedure for this arithmetic problem.

The agent did not require any guidance about day-of-week calculation, handling of date arithmetic, or format correction. The simple pass-through of the question and extraction of the answer line already produces the correct weekday name.

The evidence provides no moment in any trajectory where different text in the harness would have changed the outcome. The task is already solved correctly and cheaply.
</notes>
